import json,pathlib,resource,subprocess,time,traceback
import chess
import torch
from harbichess.backends.torch_network import load_weights,sha256
from harbichess.chess.actions import move_to_action
from harbichess.chess.encoding import BoardEncoder
root=pathlib.Path('/workspace/HarbiChess');out=root/'artifacts/ufuk-compile-20261003-v2';out.mkdir(exist_ok=False)
started,cpu=time.perf_counter(),time.process_time();torch.set_num_threads(1)
weights=root/'artifacts/ufuk-all-train-20261003/checkpoints/step-009250/model.safetensors';network=load_weights(weights).eval()
assert network.architecture == 'pairwise'
graph=torch.compile(network._features,backend='inductor',fullgraph=True,dynamic=True)
def compiled(inputs,actions):
 if actions.ndim!=2 or actions.shape[0]!=inputs.shape[0] or actions.shape[1]==0:
  raise ValueError('invalid masked action shape')
 if torch.any(actions<0) or torch.any(actions>=network.config.policy_size):
  raise ValueError('invalid masked action bounds')
 return graph(inputs,actions)
fens=[chess.STARTING_FEN,'r3k2r/8/8/8/8/8/8/R3K2R w KQkq - 0 1','r3k2r/8/8/8/8/8/8/R3K2R b KQkq - 0 1','4k3/P7/8/8/8/8/7p/4K3 w - - 0 1','4k3/P7/8/8/8/8/7p/4K3 b - - 0 1','4k3/8/8/3pP3/8/8/8/4K3 w - d6 0 1']
status='passed';error=None;cases=[]
try:
 with torch.inference_mode():
  for batch in [1,8,32]:
   for fen in fens:
    board=chess.Board(fen);position=BoardEncoder().encode_board(board)
    x=torch.tensor(position.values).reshape(1,8,8,104).repeat(batch,1,1,1)
    actions=torch.tensor([[move_to_action(board,m) for m in board.legal_moves]]*batch)
    expected=network.masked_policy_value(x,actions);actual=compiled(x,actions)
    for a,e in zip(actual,expected,strict=True):
     assert torch.isfinite(a).all();torch.testing.assert_close(a,e,atol=2e-5,rtol=2e-5)
    cases.append({'fen':fen,'batch':batch,'legal':actions.shape[1],'max_policy_error':float((actual[0]-expected[0]).abs().max()),'max_value_error':float((actual[1]-expected[1]).abs().max())})
except BaseException as exc:
 status='failed';error=f'{type(exc).__name__}: {exc}';(out/'failure.txt').write_text(traceback.format_exc())
report={'status':status,'error':error,'source_commit':subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse','HEAD'],cwd=root,text=True).strip(),'weights_sha256':sha256(weights),'script_sha256':sha256(pathlib.Path(__file__)),'torch':torch.__version__,'backend':'inductor','fullgraph':True,'dynamic':True,'compile_threads':1,'device':'cpu','torch_threads':1,'wall_seconds':time.perf_counter()-started,'cpu_seconds':time.process_time()-cpu,'maxrss_kib':resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_SELF).ru_maxrss,'cases':cases,'scope':'setup/parity only during actor play; no warmed speed result yet'}
(out/'setup.json').write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2)+'\n');print(json.dumps(report));assert status=='passed','compiler experiment rejected'
